title: 基礎奠定核心單字 (TOEIC 400-600) - 第 2 單元 (401~800 字)
description: 多益入門必備單字與基礎情境片語，涵蓋辦公室基本溝通與日常商務。（分單元 2/9）

words.definitionZh: 延遲的；被延遲的

examples.scenario: 日常商務 (圖像記憶錨點)
examples.en: Maintaining a delayed working arrangement enables our team to respond swiftly to unexpected client demands.
examples.zh: 保持【延遲的】的工作安排，使我們團隊能迅速回應突發的客戶需求。

examples.en: The chief executive officer delivered a delayed presentation outlining our long-term sustainable growth model.
examples.zh: 執行長發表了一場【延遲的】的簡報，概述了我們長期的永續成長模式。

examples.zh: 建立【延遲的】的商業合作夥伴關係，對於在海外市場拓展企業版圖至關重要。

quizzes.stem: The board of directors commended the cross-functional team for their _____ performance during the product launch.

quizzes.stemTranslation: 在該商務備忘錄中，單字「delayed」（【延遲的】）的意思與下列何者最接近？

examples.scenario: 日常商務 (圖像記憶錨點)
examples.en: During the annual shareholders meeting, executive directors highlighted the fundamental importance of experiences.
examples.zh: 在年度股東大會上，執行董事們強調了【經歷】的根本重要性。

examples.en: The plant supervisor implemented strict operational guidelines to ensure consistent quality in experiences.
examples.zh: 廠房主管實施了嚴格的營運準則，以確保在【經歷】方面保持一致的高品質。

examples.en: Strategic investment in experiences has positioned our enterprise as a frontrunner in global market competition.
examples.zh: 在【經歷】上的策略性投資，使我司在全球市場競爭中躍居領先地位。

quizzes.stem: The regional director emphasized that corporate _____ remains our highest priority for the upcoming fiscal year.
quizzes.stemTranslation: 區域總監強調，企業【經歷】依然是我們下一會計年度的首要重點。
quizzes.strategy: 空格位於 corporate 之後作為名詞主詞/受詞，選入名詞 experiences 最切合商務方針。

optionAnalyses.reason: 【正解】詞義「經歷」與文法形態完全切合題幹之商務語境。
【干擾】此選項與題幹前後文意及商務搭配不符，予以排除。

Subject: Important Operational Update

To: Global Procurement Partners
Subject: Partnership and Service Confirmation

We are delighted to confirm that our organization can _____ your upcoming business requirements on schedule.

To: All Branch Directors
Subject: Long-term Development Framework

The executive board has approved comprehensive guidelines to _____ sustainable performance across all regional subsidiaries.

examples.scenario: 日常商務 (圖像記憶錨點)
examples.en: The facility management team worked diligently to explain the urgent requirements of visiting international delegates.
examples.zh: 廠區管理團隊辛勤作業，以【解釋】來訪國際代表的緊急需求。

examples.en: Our executive board decided to explain operational protocols in order to boost overall supply chain resilience.
examples.zh: 我們的執行董事會決定【解釋】營運規範，以增強整體供應鏈之韌性。

quizzes.stem: The executive management committee agreed to _____ the client's urgent proposal after a detailed evaluation.

quizzes.strategy: 空格前有 agreed to（接原形動詞），受詞為 the client's urgent proposal，填入 explain 最符合語意搭配。
quizzes.examTrapTip: 注意動詞受詞搭配與語意邏輯，避免誤選意思不合之干擾動詞。

quizzes.strategy: 在商務語境中，hold（握住）之核心涵義與 hold 最相近。
quizzes.examTrapTip: 多益同義字測驗考查商務上下文語境，需選擇最具替換性之選項。

optionAnalyses.reason: 【正解】在商務語境中為最精確之同義詞替換。
【干擾】語意不符或無法替換題幹單字。

To: All Department Staff
Subject: Important Operational Update

Please ensure that our division takes all necessary measures to _____ established corporate benchmarks across daily operations.
quizzes.stemTranslation:

收件人：全體部門同仁
主旨：重要營運更新

quizzes.strategy: 內部備忘錄公告提及 takes measures to _____（採取措施以...），填入 hold 最切合商務政策語境。
quizzes.examTrapTip: 內部行政備忘錄常使用正式書面語體與政策規章搭配。

optionAnalyses.reason: 【正解】詞義「握住」與文法形態完全切合題幹之商務語境。

quizzes.strategy: 在商務語境中，instead of（代替）之核心涵義與 instead of 最相近。

optionAnalyses.reason: 【正解】在商務語境中為最精確之同義詞替換。
